mapper.select: select PROD_REGIST_CODE from FIN_PRODUCT_ADD T1 inner join FIN_PRODUCT T2 on T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID where T2.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{product} and T2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{portfolioId}
select T1.CALENDAR_ID calId, T2.RED_SPEED redSpeed, T2.PUR_SPEED speed from FIN_PRODUCT T1 left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD T2 on T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID where T1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

SELECT tpd.SETTLE_SPEED, tpd.TRADE_ID, tpd.FINPROD_TYPE2, tpda.ENTRUST_ID, tpda.RED_CFM_DATE, tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID, tpd.SETTLE_SPEED, tpd.TRADE_DATE, tpd.SETTLE_DATE, tpd.PS, tpd.FINPROD_ID, fp.FINPROD_NAME, tpd.TRADE_MARKET, tpd.TRADE_PLAT, tpd.TRADE_MARKET_MODE, tpd.FEE_AMT_PAY, tpd.INV_AIM, tpd.F_TRADE_ID, tpd.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, tpd.CCY, tpd.TRADE_AMT, tpd.PRIN_AMT, tpd.SHARE_AMT, tpd.UNIT_CPRICE, tpd.UNIT_INT, tpd.UNIT_FPRICE, tpd.CPRICE_DATE, tpd.CPRICE_AMT, tpd.B_TRADE_ID, tpd.P_TRADE_ID, tpd.CPRICE_DATE, tpd.INT_AMT, tpd.FPRICE_AMT, tpd.YIELD, tpd.EXER_YIELD, tpd.REMARK, tpd.TRADER, tpd.COUNTER_ID, tpd.COUNTER_TRADER, tpd.COUNTER_CONTACT FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpda ON tpda.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN WFL_PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL ptpd ON ptpd.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = tpd.FINPROD_ID WHERE tpd.TRADE_ID = #{tradId}

SELECT VALUATION FROM FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION
FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and VAL_DATE = to_date(#{netDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')

SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID hidCode, PORTFOLIO_ID code, PORTFOLIO_NAME name, PORTFOLIO_NAME shortName FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO
PORTFOLIO_ID = #{initValue}
and (PORTFOLIO_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR PORTFOLIO_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )
and PORTFOLIO_ID in (select PORTFOLIO_ID from PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY where USER_ID = #{loginUserName})
select count(*) from LQD_PIPELINE_MATCH where SYS_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

SELECT DISTINCT case SPO.PS when '${IE_FLAG_02}' then SPO.MY_ACCT_NO else SPO.COUNTER_ACCT_NO end payAcctNo, case SPO.PS when '${IE_FLAG_02}' then SPO.COUNTER_ACCT_NO else SPO.MY_ACCT_NO end recAcctNo, case SPO.PS when '${IE_FLAG_02}' then SCI.ACCT_NAME else SCI1.ACCT_NAME end payAcctName, case SPO.PS when '${IE_FLAG_02}' then SCI1.ACCT_NAME else SCI.ACCT_NAME end recAcctName, SPO.PS, SPO.IS_NEED_SEND, SPO.PAY_TYPE, SPO.SETTLE_DATE, SPO.SETTLE_AMT, SPO.CCY, SPO.PORTFOLIO_ID, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME, SPO.SETTLE_STATUS, SPO.PURPOSE, SPO.TRADE_ID, SPO.ORDER_ID FROM WFL_STL_PAY_ORDERS SPO LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO SCI ON SPO.MY_ACCT_NO = SCI.ACCT_NO LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO SCI1 ON SPO.COUNTER_ACCT_NO = SCI1.ACCT_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON SPO.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE SPO.TRADE_ID = #{bizCode}

SELECT TRADE_ID tradId, '1' workflowId FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL
B_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} AND TOTLE_TRADE_ID IS NULL
AND IS_CANCEL = #{N}
AND IS_CANCEL = 'N' and TRADE_STATUS = '01'

SELECT tpd.*, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, fp.FINPROD_NAME, fpt.TYPE_6, fpt.TYPE_9, fpt.TYPE_10, fpt.TYPE_11 FROM (SELECT T1.TRADE_ID, '02' VALID_STATUS, T1.FINPROD_TYPE2, T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.PS, T1.TRADE_MARKET, T1.TRADE_PLAT, T1.TRADE_MARKET_MODE, T1.TRADE_AMT, T1.PRIN_AMT, T1.SHARE_AMT, T1.CCY, T1.TRADE_DATE, T1.SETTLE_DATE, T1.REMARK, null WORKFLOW_ID, null WORKFLOW_STATUS, T1.B_TRADE_ID, T2.ENTRUST_ID, pp.PORTFOLIO_ID, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME, pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON T1.TRADE_ID = PT.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE PP.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' AND (T1.IS_CANCEL is null or T1.IS_CANCEL = 'N') and T1.TRADE_STATUS = '01' and T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = ( select TOTLE_TRADE_ID from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where TRADE_ID = #{tradeId})) tpd LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = tpd.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON fpt.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID

select tpd.TRADE_ID tradeId, tpda.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, nvl(pt.PORTFOLIO_ID, tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID) portfolioId, ee.ENTRUST_AMT - tpd.TRADE_AMT doEntrustMoney, tpd.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt, tpd.SHARE_AMT shareAmt from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpda on tpda.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID left join ETR_ENTRUST ee on ee.ENTRUST_ID = tpda.ENTRUST_ID
left join ptl_trade pt on pt.BUSI_NO = tpd.TRADE_ID and pt.PORTFOLIO_ID != tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID
where tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totleTradeId} order by tpd.create_time
SELECT nvl(Entrust_Amt,0) entrustAmt, nvl(Entrust_Num,0) entrustNum FROM ETR_ENTRUST WHERE ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}

SELECT PRIN_AMT FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE TRADE_ID IN (SELECT TRADE_ID FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD WHERE ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}) and TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS} and IS_CANCEL = 'N' and R_TRADE_ID is null UNION ALL SELECT PRIN_AMT FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE TRADE_ID IN (SELECT TRADE_ID FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD WHERE ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}) and TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS} and IS_CANCEL = 'N' and R_TRADE_ID is null

SELECT SHARE_AMT FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE TRADE_ID IN (SELECT TRADE_ID FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD WHERE ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}) and TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS} and IS_CANCEL = 'N' and R_TRADE_ID is null UNION ALL SELECT SHARE_AMT FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE TRADE_ID IN (SELECT TRADE_ID FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD WHERE ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}) and TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS} and IS_CANCEL = 'N' and R_TRADE_ID is null
